title: The Last Message
description: Every night at 2:13 AM, she receives a message from someone who died years ago.

seasons.title: The Echo
seasons.description: Where the past refuses to stay buried.

parts.text: The phone buzzed again. This time, the message only had three words: Don’t trust him.
She looked at the sender ID. It was the same number she had buried three years ago.
A cold sweat broke out on her forehead. The dead don't text. Do they?
